Estimated by component, using the square plate (about 26 cm) as the ruler:

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Scrambled eggs | 60 | 95 |
| Pineapple | 70 | 35 |
| Watermelon | 150 | 45 |
| Honeydew | 60 | 22 |
| Roasted sweet potato | 40 | 45 (including oil) |
| Salad (spinach, carrot, tomato, cucumber) | 40 | 10 |
| **Total** | **420** | **~252** |

I rounded the energy up slightly to allow for any oil or dressing not visible.

{"kcal": 260, "mass_g": 420}
